create_tcp_proxy: create a TcpProxy instance to proxy TCP connections between a client and server for testing
start_tcp_proxy: start the TcpProxy to begin listening on a bound address and forwarding traffic to the gateway
get_proxy_port: get the dynamically assigned port number from a started TcpProxy instance
get_byte_count: get the sent and received byte counts from the TcpProxy to monitor traffic volume
stop_tcp_proxy: stop the TcpProxy and close all associated sockets and threads cleanly
